e.body:
The Geneva Papers on Risk and Insurance – Issues and Practice 是 **[[geneva-association]]（日内瓦协会）的旗舰期刊**，由 Springer/Palgrave 出版（`link.springer.com/journal/41288`）。可核实信息：**印刷 ISSN 1018-5895 / 电子 ISSN 1468-0440**；**Journal Impact Factor 1.3（2025）**、五年影响因子 2.1（2025）；**投稿到首次决定中位数 9 天**；出版模式为 **Hybrid**；期刊自述为「推进全球保险业科学知识的旗舰期刊（Flagship journal）」。近期开放获取文章示例：*Systemic cyber risks and insurance regulatory capital*（2026-08）。

对 RIAA：这份期刊的定位与另两份**明显不同**——[[astin-bulletin]] 与 [[european-actuarial-journal]] 偏**数理方法论**，而 Geneva Papers 偏**保险业的经济、监管与实务议题**（风险与保险的经济学、监管资本、网络风险、气候与保障缺口等），因此它是「**方法论期刊 → 行业与政策期刊**」两个层次里的后者；这与本 wiki 的行业与政策条目天然配套：全球智库研究见 [[geneva-association]]，行业联合会立场见 [[insurance-europe]]，行业基准数据见 [[swiss-re-sigma]]，治理议题见 [[insurance-governance]]，网络风险与资本议题可对照 [[cyber-risk-classification]]、[[cat-bond-pricing]]。适合作行业研究、监管与政策方向的论文阅读与选题。**核实说明**：期刊主页 HTTP 200（225KB）实测，未核实文章全文。
e.body_en:
The Geneva Papers on Risk and Insurance – Issues and Practice is **the flagship journal of [[geneva-association]]**, published by Springer/Palgrave (`link.springer.com/journal/41288`). Verifiable details: **print ISSN 1018-5895 / electronic ISSN 1468-0440**; **Journal Impact Factor 1.3 (2025)** and five-year IF 2.1 (2025); **median submission-to-first-decision of 9 days**; **Hybrid** publishing model; and it describes itself as a "Flagship journal" advancing scientific knowledge of the insurance industry globally. A recent open-access example: *Systemic cyber risks and insurance regulatory capital* (August 2026).

For RIAA: its positioning differs **markedly** from the other two — [[astin-bulletin]] and [[european-actuarial-journal]] lean **mathematical/ methodological**, whereas the Geneva Papers leans toward the **economics, regulation and practice of the insurance industry** (the economics of risk and insurance, regulatory capital, cyber risk, climate and the protection gap). It is therefore the latter of two layers — "**methodology journals → industry and policy journals**" — and pairs naturally with this wiki’s industry and policy entries: global think-tank research in [[geneva-association]], industry federation positions in [[insurance-europe]], industry benchmark data in [[swiss-re-sigma]], governance topics in [[insurance-governance]], and cyber risk and capital topics against [[cyber-risk-classification]] and [[cat-bond-pricing]]. Suits reading and topic selection for industry research, regulation and policy work. **Verification note**: the journal home page was measured at HTTP 200 (225KB); article full texts were not verified.

The Geneva Papers on Risk and Insurance – Issues and Practice 是 **[[geneva-association]]（日內瓦協會）的旗艦期刊**，由 Springer/Palgrave 出版。可核實資訊：**印刷 ISSN 1018-5895 / 電子 ISSN 1468-0440**；**Journal Impact Factor 1.3（2025）**、五年影響因子 2.1（2025）；**投稿到首次決定中位數 9 天**；出版模式為 **Hybrid**；自述為「推進全球保險業科學知識的旗艦期刊」。近期開放獲取文章示例：*Systemic cyber risks and insurance regulatory capital*（2026-08）。

對 RIAA：這份期刊的定位與另兩份**明顯不同**——[[astin-bulletin]] 與 [[european-actuarial-journal]] 偏**數理方法論**，而 Geneva Papers 偏**保險業的經濟、監管與實務議題**（監管資本、網絡風險、氣候與保障缺口等），是「**方法論期刊 → 行業與政策期刊**」兩個層次裡的後者；與本 wiki 行業與政策條目天然配套：[[geneva-association]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[swiss-re-sigma]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[cyber-risk-classification]]、[[cat-bond-pricing]]。適合作行業研究、監管與政策方向的論文閱讀與選題。**核實說明**：期刊主頁 HTTP 200 實測，未核實文章全文。
